title: (Un)intentional reference to ‘The Cook, the Thief, his Wide and Her Lover’ in ‘La La Land’?

commenti.body: Probably less a direct narrative reference than just loving the shot and recreating it/using it as homage for his film. I feel like I've seen several aspects of La La Land that do similar things (with Sweet Charity's musical numbers, for instance, or The Young Girls of Rochefort)
